git clone https://github.com/falkenber9/falcon.git
cd falcon
mkdir build
cd build
cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr ../
make

# Install (optional)
sudo make install

# Uninstall (use carefully!)
sudo xargs rm < install_manifest.txt
